method: Private original functions; independent new SVG models; source scripts and source artwork are not published

results.scope: Private original numerical/update functions versus independently authored native equations. Every declared single-control level with other controls at default; all ray construction steps; discrete numerical histories and wavelength samples. Native extension controls are excluded from original equivalence. Simultaneous slider domains, arbitrary event orders and pixel equivalence are not exhausted.
